bank_name: Global Islami Bank PLC (formerly NRB Global Bank Limited)
period_note: Unaudited interim financial statements 'As at 31 March 2025'. THIS FILING IS ON THE FULLY-RESTATED, AUDIT-CONSISTENT BASIS: its own '31 December 2024' comparative column matches this dataset's audited 2024_Q4.json EXACTLY, to the Taka, across every balance-sheet line checked -- Total assets 192,203,561,918, Total Liabilities 213,695,921,209, Total Shareholders' Equity -21,492,359,291, Investments 144,278,123,155, Deposits 132,905,663,809. This confirms the restatement discovered in 2024_Q1.json/2024_Q2.json/2024_Q3.json's period_notes had fully propagated into the bank's own interim reporting basis by the time this filing was prepared (uploaded August 2025, shortly after the FY2024 annual report itself, auditor-signed 9-12 July 2025) -- there is a clean, reconcilable break between 2024_Q3.json (last pre/mid-restatement filing) and this filing, not a smooth quarter-to-quarter progression. Equity deepened FURTHER and dramatically this quarter alone: from -21,492.36m (Dec-2024, audited) to -28,904.26m (Mar-2025), a single-quarter net loss of -7,411.90m -- almost 60% the size of the ENTIRE FY2024 audited annual loss (-12,466.18m), incurred in just three months. This filing's P&L and Balance Sheet are fully internally consistent: opening equity (-21,492,359,291) + this quarter's own PAT (-7,411,896,729) = closing equity (-28,904,256,020), matching the Balance Sheet's own Total Shareholders' Equity figure exactly. Total Operating Income turned NEGATIVE this quarter (-314.34m) -- Net Investment Income itself was negative (-470.50m), meaning the cost of profit paid to depositors now exceeds gross investment income, consistent with a collapsing earning-asset base where a large share of investments have stopped accruing income (per the FY2024 annual report's own disclosure of a 90.72% non-performing investment ratio). A single 'Specific provision on classified investments' charge of approximately 6,006.07m dominates this quarter's Total Provision of 6,071.01m.
